title: c vars
description: Variables for Unified C Toolchain Router (c)

C_INSTALL_METHOD.description: How to install C ('libscript_native' uses isolated version dirs, 'from-source' compiles from source, 'system' uses OS package manager, 'mise', 'asdf', 'pkgx', or 'vfox' defers to third-party tools).

C_VERSION.description: Version of C Toolchain to install

CC_BACKEND.description: Active C compiler backend routed by c ('default', 'gcc', 'clang', 'tcc', 'custom-cc').

C_PKG_MGR.description: Explicit package manager override for C toolchain installation.

C_BUILD_TOOLCHAIN.description: Bootstrap C toolchain used when building C toolchain from source.
